deficits.evidence: No crossing facility visible at the junction despite crossing demand from shops and buildings on both sides
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked zebra crossing with a refuge island to provide a safe crossing for pedestrians at this junction.

deficits.evidence: The road has 4 or more lanes and no refuge for pedestrians at the crossing
deficits.suggestion: Introduce a refuge island in the middle of the crossing to ensure pedestrian safety on this wide road.

ratings.reason: There is no marked crossing on the right side of the junction despite the presence of a gas station and other buildings.
The road is wide with multiple lanes and lacks a central refuge island for pedestrians.
